Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with…error of the wicked, fall from your…stedfastness. But grow in grace,…in the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
